sourceCode: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE test_proc IS BEGIN INSERT INTO TBL_PEDIDOS_PENDIENTES (id, producto) SELECT id, producto FROM TBL_INVENTARIO; UPDATE TBL_INVENTARIO SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM TBL_PEDIDOS_PENDIENTES); INSERT INTO TBL_FACTURAS_EMITIDAS (id) SELECT id FROM TBL_INVENTARIO; INSERT INTO TBL_LOG_ERRORES (msg) SELECT 'OK' FROM TBL_FACTURAS_EMITIDAS; END;
